messages:
Mia Chen: Hey team — product wants to onboard Logflare to surface session analytics for onboarding flows. Vendor is asking read access to logs in project "analytics-prod" (index + raw events). Quick privacy/security check: what's the minimal scope we can give and what redaction must be done? They want to run queries and tail a subset for debugging.

Sam Patel: @Mia Chen thanks — need details on which indices/streams. In general: 1) never share raw request bodies that may contain PII, 2) supply a role with read-only access limited to specific index ARNs, 3) require time-limited creds + auditable API key, 4) redact emails/phones and hash IDs before giving access. Do you have an example event?

Mia Chen: example snippet we saw in logs (sanitized):
```
{"user_id":"user_12345","email":"alice@example.com","path":"/signup","session_id":"abcd-efgh","event":"click"}
```

Sam Patel: ok — that contains email -> we should strip/replace with <REDACTED_EMAIL> or hash it. Also remove device fingerprints. If vendor can accept hashed identifiers, prefer HMAC with customer salt. Also enforce KMS-wrapped creds and restricted IP allowlist.

Jordan Lee: infra notes: we can create an IAM role `logflare_read_analytics_prod` scoped to `arn:aws:es:us-west-2:123456789012:domain/analytics-prod/*` and deny `es:ESHttpPost`/write. We can issue a short-lived STS role/session that Logflare exchanges via OIDC. Retention: set view window 30d. We can add a query-level filter to drop `email` and `ip` fields at the ingest pipeline.

Priya Kaur: timeline: product needs this in staging by next Tue for research. Can we do a canary for staging-only first?

Logflare Support: we can support read-only integrations and respect ingest pipeline redaction. We can accept either: (a) metadata-only (event types + hashed ids) or (b) hashed identifiers + no raw bodies. We also support per-index ACLs and rotating API keys. Example config we can use:
```
{ "source": "aws-es","indices": ["analytics-prod-*"], "fields_exclude": ["email","ip_address"], "auth": {"type":"sts","role_arn":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/logflare_read_analytics_prod"} }
```

Mia Chen: sounds good. Proposal: create staging-only role + rotate creds every 24h, apply ingest pipeline to drop email/ip, set retention 30d. Sam, approve to provision the staging role?

Sam Patel: +1 to staging-only canary. Approve with conditions: 1) ingest pipeline verified in a sandbox, 2) ephemeral creds (max 24h), 3) audit logs forwarded to our SIEM, 4) vendor signs DPA addendum for no-attempt-to-reidentify. After staging validation, we can evaluate prod access.

infra-bot: role `logflare_read_staging_analytics` created (expires in 24h) — creds pending rotation job.

Mia Chen: thanks all — I'll coordinate the DPA with legal and ping @Logflare Support to accept staging role. I'll post updates here once staging is up. :thumbsup:
